news.title: GLP-1 drugs could have a surprisingly large environmental payoff
paras: lower demand GLP-1 drugs could have a surprisingly large environmental payoff GLP-1 drugs could cut food demand enough to free farmland larger than Italy. If widely used, our new research suggests these appetite-suppressing medicines could transform the global food system and free up vast areas of agricultural land.

The global food system is ultimately driven by demand. If people eat less, producers respond, affecting production, prices, trade, and how much land is needed. We used a powerful computer simulation to explore scenarios ranging from GLP-1 use concentrated in high-income countries to widespread global access.

news.title: 10 things that worry me about chasing the 2027 total solar eclipse in Egypt
paras: The longest total solar eclipse on land this century promises to be the experience of a lifetime, but watching it from Luxor, Egypt, may not be straightforward. (Image credit: Ratnakorn Piyasirisorost via Getty Images) Jump To: 1.

2, 2027, I'll be in Luxor, Egypt, to witness what could be the greatest total solar eclipse of my life. I've seen nine total solar eclipses across the world, but this one promises to be different. For a remarkable six minutes and 22 seconds, the moon will completely cover the sun, plunging Egypt's ancient temples and monuments into eerie twilight as the solar corona bursts into view.

sport.title: November 22, 2015: The day Novak Djokovic won a record fourth straight ATP World Tour Finals in London
paras: Every day Tennis Majors looks back at the biggest moments in tennis history. On November 22, 2015, Novak Djokovic capped an exceptional season by clinching a record fourth consecutive Masters title On this day, November 22, 2015, Novak Djokovic defeated Roger Federer in the final of the ATP World Tour Finals (6-3, 6-4).

Novak Djokovic was born in 1987 in Belgrade. He entered the top 100 in 2005, finishing the year as world No 83. In 2006, he announced his arrival on the big stage by reaching the quarter-finals at Roland-Garros while being ranked only No 63, after he beat world No 9 Fernando Gonzalez in the second round.

sport.title: Alexander Zverev ties Pete Sampras’ personal record at the ATP Finals ahead of Carlos Alcaraz showdown
paras: Alexander Zverev has once again proven himself to be a force on indoor hard courts. The German superstar advanced to his third ATP Finals final in nine years after defeating Daniil Medvedev on Saturday evening.

Only Carlos Alcaraz stands in the way of Zverev claiming his third ATP Finals title. If Zverev wins the title on Sunday, he will equal John McEnroe and Boris Becker for the fifth-most ATP Finals title wins since the tournament’s inception in 1970. Zverev has already made tennis history ahead of Sunday’s final, tying one of Pete Sampras’ personal records.

paras: Alexander Zverev advanced to the final of the ATP Finals on Saturday evening. The world number one overcame the challenge presented by 2021 US Open champion Daniil Medvedev , beating the Russian 7-6, 6-4 at the Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy.

sport.title: Boris Becker ‘surprised’ by what Carlos Alcaraz has done this season
paras: Carlos Alcaraz is approaching the end of what has been a tumultuous 2026 season for him.

Alcaraz won the Australian Open in his first tournament of the year, which enabled him to become the youngest man in history to complete the Career Grand Slam, and went on a 16-match winning streak to start the year. However, this was the last Grand Slam tournament Alcaraz played until the US Open , having missed both Roland Garros and Wimbledon due to a right wrist injury he suffered during the clay court season.
